* Zil: 2400 | damage 0star = * Thungr: ** Attack: 150 Blunt, 100 Chop, 40 Pickaxe ** Rage attack: 130 Blunt, 100 Chop, 40 Pickaxe * Zil: ** Fireball: 20 Blunt, 100 Fire | abilities = * Thungr: ** Attack (2 seconds) ** Rage attack (20 seconds) * Zil: ** Fireball (12 seconds) ** Protect (40 seconds) ** Regular Fuling shaman abilities when alone |immune=Spirit|stagger=30%| faction = Plains}} '''Zil & Thungr''' is an aggressive duo miniboss found in [[Plains]] inside [[Sealed tower]]. == Attacks and abilities == {{For|strategies for defeating Zil & Thungr|Boss strategies#Zil & Thungr}} === Attack (Thungr) === Swings his club in a 4-meter 70-degree horizontal arc in front of himself (150 [[Damage types#Blunt|Blunt]], 100 Tier 2 [[Damage types#Chop|Chop]] and 40 Tier 2 [[Damage types#Pickaxe|Pickaxe]] damage). This attack can be used within 3 meters of the player every 2 seconds. It has two variations: a regular swing and delayed swingThe timing difference between the regular swing and the delayed swing is approximately 0.297 seconds.. === Rage attack (Thungr) === Slams his club into the ground 3 times extending out 4 meters and arcing 60 degrees vertically, stepping forward with each swing (130 [[Damage types#Blunt|Blunt]], 100 Tier 2 [[Damage types#Chop|Chop]] and 40 Tier 2 [[Damage types#Pickaxe|Pickaxe]] damage each). He can do this every 20 seconds when within 6 meters of a player. === Fireball (Zil) === Zil shoots a fireball at the player, inflicting the [[Burning]] status (20 [[Damage types#Blunt|Blunt]] and 100 [[Damage types#Fire|Fire]] damage). This attack has a 12-second cooldown and can be used when within 20 meters of a player. The fireball travels at 15 meters per second for up to 4 seconds before despawning. It has a spread of 4–20 degrees from the center of his aim. === Protect (Zil) === Casts a protective barrier over all allies within a 6-meter radius, negating up to 100 damage before breaking or lasting for up to 40 seconds. This ability has a 40-second cooldown and can be used within 60 meters of a player. When Thungr is killed, Zil is left alone and his attack pool is reverted to that of a regular [[Fuling Shaman]]. == Drops == {{drop table| {{drop row|item=Hildir's bronze chest|0star=1}} {{drop row|creature=Zil|item=Zil trophy|0star=100%}} {{drop row|creature=Thungr|item=Thungr trophy|0star=100%}} |stars=0}} == Notes == * Zil & Thungr are the first creatures in ''Valheim'' that work as a duo. * Even though they are supposed to be fought as a duo, players can spawn them separately thanks to their Internal IDs. ** Zil's Internal ID is ''GoblinShaman_Hildir'' ** Thungr's Internal ID is ''GoblinBrute_Hildir'' * Zil is the one that drops [[Hildir's bronze chest]]. == Trivia == * According to their trophy descriptions, Zil is older than Thungr, despite the former's size being smaller than the latter. * Zil & Thungr have an envy of each other. Zil is jealous of Thungr's strength, and Thungr is jealous of Zil's magical power. * Zil can still cast his elemental attacks while swimming. * When spawning Thungr with cheats, his corpse is the normal green, instead of blue. * Summoned starred variants of Thungr are brown, where as Zil's stay true to his normal color. == Gallery == #Name of Image.jpg|#Description of image here {{Creatures}} [[Category:Creatures]] [[Category:Minibosses]] [[de:Zil & Thungr]] [[ru:Зил и Тангр]] [[uk:Зіл і Танґр]]

'''Lord Reto''' is a [[Creatures|miniboss]] found in the [[Ashlands]]. He is part of the sub-quest to craft the [[Dyrnwyn]].

He can be found inside the dungeon [[Tomb of Lord Reto]]. The location of the dungeon is given by following a series of 3 [[Vegvisir]]s, see [[Mysterious Location]] for details.

== Attacks and abilities ==
{{For|strategies for defeating Lord Reto|Boss strategies#Lord Reto}}
Lord Reto spawns naturally with 2 stars, so all of his stats are listed with those [[Creature Level#Effects|multipliers]] taken into account. He has an attack move set similar to a regular [[Charred Warrior]], but more health and damage than even a 2-starred Charred Warrior. He is also capable of killing a player in one-hit, even if they have got the currently max health and [[Flametal Armor|best armor]] possible. ([[Piquant Pie]], [[Mashed Meat]] and [[Fiery Svinstew]] which provides 300 health.)

=== Swing ===
A vertical sword slash that creates a 3-meter 115-degree arc in front (480 [[Damage types#Slash|Slash]] damage). It can be used every 3 seconds when within 1.6 meters of a player.

=== Thrust ===
A forward stab that extends in a 3-meter line which arcs slightly by 10 degrees (460 [[Damage types#Pierce|Pierce]] damage). This attack can be used every 3 seconds when within 1.6 meters of a player.

=== Feint ===
Shares the same windup as the swing, but Lord Reto will suddenly pause before shifting stances to attack with a different slash that hits in a 3-meter 77.3-degree vertical arc (500 [[Damage types#Slash|Slash]] damage). It can be used every 8 seconds when within 1.6 meters of a player. There is practically no difference between the animation for this attack and that of the regular swing<ref group="Note">The timing difference between the regular swing and the feint is approximately 0.57 seconds.</ref>; there is more than enough time to react and parry again, but the attack will catch rolling players unless completely moving out of his range.

=== Thrust feint ===
Shares the same windup as the thrust, but Lord Reto will suddenly pause before attacking with an upward swing from his current stance (420 [[Damage types#Pierce|Pierce]] damage). This attack creates a vertical arc that is 3 meters long and spans 60 degrees. It can be used every 3 seconds when within 1.6 meters of a player. Similar to the regular feint, there is practically no difference between the animation for this attack and that of the regular thrust<ref group="Note">The timing difference between the thrust and the feint thrust is approximately 0.631 seconds.</ref>; there is more than enough time to react and parry again, but the attack will catch rolling players unless completely moving out of his range.
